title: Ansel and the Garden
author: Rosalind Coldharbour
blurb: Jonah Ravensworth, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
